description: Returns a number that is rounded up to the nearest integer or to the nearest multiple of significance. The number is always rounded up regardless of its sign.

params.description: The multiple of significance to round up to. If it is omitted, the default value of 1 is used. If it is set to zero, the function returns 0.
params.name: arg2

signature: CEILING_PRECISE(arg1: ApiRange | ApiName | number, arg2?: ApiRange | ApiName | number): number
